title: ICAT Issues First Compliance Certificate for 15-Metre Multi-Axle Sleeper Bus
subtitle: Certification Awarded to Synaty Automotive Pvt. Ltd.
body_text:
Manesar, Haryana: In a significant development for India's passenger transport sector, the International Centre for Automotive Technology (ICAT) has issued its first compliance certificate for a 15-metre multi-axle sleeper bus under AIS-119 and AIS-153, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR).
The certificate has been awarded to Synaty Automotive Pvt. Ltd. for its 15-metre multi-axle sleeper bus. The achievement represents an important milestone in the testing and certification of one of the longest permissible bus body configurations in the passenger transport category.
The certificate was formally handed over by Shri Saurabh Dalela, Director, ICAT, to Shri Naresh Kumar Yadav, Managing Director, Synaty Automotive Pvt. Ltd., in the presence of senior ICAT officials.
Advanced Configuration for Long-Distance Travel
The vehicle has been designed for long-distance passenger transportation, incorporating features focused on structural strength, emergency safety, fire safety, passenger movement and travel comfort.
The bus has a capacity of 42 berths (for fully sleeper variant) and 21 berths + 42 seats (for hybrid sleeper variant), providing an integrated solution for long-distance travel.
It has been tested and certified against the applicable requirements related to vehicle safety, structural integrity, passenger accommodation and comfort, as prescribed under the relevant automotive standards and CMVR.
Strengthening Passenger Vehicle Safety
The certification under AIS-119:and AIS-153 demonstrates ICAT's capability in evaluating advanced passenger vehicle configurations and supporting manufacturers in meeting prescribed regulatory and technical requirements.
Speaking on the occasion, Shri Saurabh Dalela, Director, ICAT, said:
«“This certification is a significant achievement for ICAT and reflects our technical capabilities in testing and certifying advanced passenger vehicles. It reinforces our commitment to passenger safety, regulatory compliance and technological advancement. ICAT will continue to support the Indian automotive industry in developing safer, more reliable and technologically advanced mobility solutions.”»
Shri Naresh Kumar Yadav, Managing Director, Synaty Automotive Pvt. Ltd., expressed his appreciation for the certification and stated that the achievement would further strengthen the company's efforts towards developing safe, reliable and comfortable solutions for long-distance passenger transportation.
ICAT continues to provide testing, certification and homologation services to support the Indian automotive industry in enhancing vehicle safety, regulatory compliance and technological innovation.
The certification marks another important step in ICAT's ongoing contribution to the development of safer, compliant and advanced passenger transport vehicles in India.

enrichment.summary: The International Centre for Automotive Technology (ICAT) in Manesar has issued its first-ever compliance certificate for a 15-metre multi-axle sleeper bus under AIS-119 and AIS-153 standards, in line with Central Motor Vehicles Rules provisions. The certificate was awarded to Synaty Automotive Pvt. Ltd. for a bus configuration offering 42 berths (fully sleeper) or 21 berths plus 42 seats (hybrid variant), aimed at long-distance passenger transport.
enrichment.context: ICAT, based in Manesar, Haryana, is one of India's key testing, certification and homologation agencies for the automotive sector, operating under the Ministry of Heavy Industries as part of the National Automotive Testing and R&D Infrastructure Project (NATRiP). AIS (Automotive Industry Standards) such as AIS-119 and AIS-153 govern bus body design, structural strength and safety requirements under the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, ensuring vehicles meet safety benchmarks before being permitted on Indian roads. This release is essentially a company-specific certification announcement highlighting a private manufacturer's product achieving regulatory compliance, rather than a new policy, scheme, or regulatory change. It has limited relevance for exam preparation beyond general awareness of ICAT's role in vehicle safety certification.
